Name: Toggle Sprint
Author: Bork8008
Description:
Toggle Sprint adds a clean, lightweight sprint toggle to Stardew Valley, designed to feel natural and unobtrusive while giving players full control over movement speed.
With a single keypress, you can enable or disable sprinting at any time. Sprint speed is fully configurable, allowing you to fine-tune how fast you move without relying on food buffs or holding down keys. Sprinting stacks naturally with boots, coffee, food buffs, and other movement modifiers, keeping the experience fully vanilla-friendly.
An optional stamina drain system is included for players who want sprinting to be a more situational choice. When enabled, sprinting can drain stamina over time and optionally turn off automatically when stamina reaches zero. This feature is completely optional and disabled by default — if stamina drain is set to zero, sprinting has no stamina cost and can be used even when stamina is empty.
Toggle Sprint supports translations for every language that Stardew Valley supports using SMAPI’s built-in translation system. All HUD messages, console messages, and configuration menu text are automatically displayed in the player’s selected language.
If you have Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) installed, Toggle Sprint can be configured directly in-game. After launching the game and loading a save, press ESC, open Options, scroll down to Mod Options, and select Toggle Sprint. From there you can change the toggle key, adjust sprint speed, enable or disable HUD messages, and configure stamina drain behavior. Changes are saved automatically.
If you do not use Generic Mod Config Menu, Toggle Sprint can still be configured manually. The mod automatically generates a config.json file the first time you load into a save with the mod installed. To generate it, install the mod, launch the game through SMAPI, load any save file, then exit the game. The config file will be located at Stardew Valley/Mods/ToggleSprint/config.json. You can open this file with any text editor, such as Notepad, and adjust the settings yourself. Any changes made to the config file take effect the next time you launch the game.
Sprinting is toggled on or off rather than held, the speed bonus remains completely invisible in the UI, and the mod works in both single-player and multiplayer. Toggle Sprint is safe to add or remove from existing saves.
